mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "requests", COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS "tokens", COALESCE(SUM(cached_tokens), 0) AS "cached", COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0) AS "prompt" FROM call_log WHERE started_at >= #{start}

SELECT CAST(started_at AS DATE) AS "d", COUNT(*) AS "cnt", COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS "tok", COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0) AS "prompt", COALESCE(SUM(completion_tokens), 0) AS "comp", COALESCE(SUM(cached_tokens), 0) AS "cached" FROM call_log WHERE started_at >= #{start} GROUP BY CAST(started_at AS DATE)

SELECT cl.key_id AS "keyId", COALESCE(k.name, '(deleted)') AS "name", COUNT(*) AS "count", COALESCE(SUM(cl.total_tokens), 0) AS "tokens" FROM call_log cl LEFT JOIN api_key k ON k.id = cl.key_id WHERE cl.started_at >= #{start} GROUP BY cl.key_id, k.name ORDER BY "count" DESC LIMIT 5
